scheme_name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
other_conditions: Disability of not less than 40% is required
Candidate must be admitted to the first year of a degree program or the second year through lateral entry in an AICTE‑approved institution
A valid income certificate issued by the State/UT Government must be enclosed
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹50,000 per annum, payable for up to 4 years for first‑year entrants and up to 3 years for lateral‑entry students.
documents_required: Valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government
